entries.text: oh-my-skill 正式上线:浏览、搜索、一键安装 Agent Skills,中英双语,安装时逐文件校验内容哈希。
entries.text_en: oh-my-skill is live: browse, search and one-click install Agent Skills, in English and Chinese, with per-file content-hash verification on install.
